title.purpose: Menu door labels and deal figures, uppercase.

price.purpose: Menu prices in tabular figures, always on a dotted leader, in Bone.

label.purpose: Nav links and chips; uppercase, 0.06em tracking.

button.purpose: Button labels, uppercase; the hero primary steps up to 1.25rem.

body.purpose: Running text sized for a phone at night.

item-name.purpose: Dish and drink names in sentence case, body face.

shadows.name: status-open-ring
shadows.purpose: Crisp ring around the open-status dot; the only shadow in the system.

shadows.name: nav-current-underline
shadows.purpose: 2px red underline marking the current page in the nav.

shadows.name: hero-scrim-phone

shadows.name: hero-scrim-desktop

motion.name: ease-out

motion.name: hero-settle
motion.purpose: The one entrance: hero photo settles.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.value: rise 0.7s: translateY(14px) opacity 0 to none, staggered 60ms

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Colour, border and background hover transitions.

motion.name: photo-hover
motion.purpose: Menu door and mosaic photos scale to 1.03-1.04 on hover.

motion.name: dock-slide

motion.name: reduced-motion

narrative.overview:
Bar 48 is the conventional bar website done properly: a dark street-level page that answers three questions before anything else (is it open, where is it, what does a beer cost) and then reads like a printed bar menu. The ground is a warm near-black, the type is off-white, and the only accent is the red of the bar's real "48" lightbox. Every other colour comes from the bar's own blue LED photography, which is allowed to carry the atmosphere so the interface does not have to.

The system is flat, square and ruled. Structure comes from 1px warm hairlines, not from cards, shadows or tints. Headings are tall, condensed and uppercase (Fira Sans Extra Condensed 800); reading text is a plain, generous grotesque (Golos Text) sized for a phone outdoors at night. Georgian runs through Noto Sans Georgian with its width axis pulled in so KA headings keep the same condensed silhouette as EN and RU.

Rejected by the user and absent from the build: a red rectangular "48" plate as the logo, neon glow, and the old template's sidebar and card grid.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-black ground, off-white type, one red.
Condensed uppercase display, plain grotesque body.
Square corners everywhere; 1px hairlines are the only structure.
Menu rows with dotted leaders and tabular prices.
Live open/closed status (Asia/Tbilisi time) as the signature element.
Photography supplies the colour; the UI supplies none.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Lightbox red is the only accent. It marks the primary action and the "48"; it is not used for headings, prices, icons, or decoration. One red-filled button per view.

rules.name: The Photographs Bring the Colour Rule
rules.body: The blue LED light in the bar's photos is the only other colour on the page. Do not echo it into the interface as a tint, gradient or glow.

rules.name: The Condensed Georgian Rule
rules.body: Under `lang="ka"`, display headings switch to `font-stretch: 75%` with no letter-spacing, so Georgian keeps the condensed sign-board shape. Never fall back to a wide Georgian face for headings.

rules.name: The Tabular Price Rule
rules.body: Every price and deal figure uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so columns of prices align.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No blur shadows, no neon glow, no coloured halos. The open-status ring (a 4px spread of Open Green at 18%) is the single exception and stays a crisp ring, not a blur.

rules.name: The Scrim-Only Gradient Rule
rules.body: Gradients exist only as dark scrims laid over photographs, in the ground colour. Never as backgrounds, buttons or text fills.

dos: **Do** set the wordmark as text: "BAR 48" in the display face, with only "48" in Lightbox Red Ink.
**Do** keep Lightbox Red for one primary action per view and the "48"; use Lightbox Red Ink, not the fill red, whenever red is text.
**Do** keep every corner square (0px) and every rule 1px, in Hairline or Hairline Strong.
**Do** put prices on dotted leaders in tabular figures, in Bone.
**Do** keep touch targets at 44px or more and primary actions at 52–56px.
**Do** switch Georgian headings to the condensed width (`font-stretch: 75%`).
**Do** let the real bar photography carry the colour, with a ground-colour scrim where text sits on it.
donts: **Don't** put the "48" on a red rectangle or plate. The user rejected it.
**Don't** add glows, neon effects, blurred shadows or coloured halos.
**Don't** use gradients other than dark scrims over photographs.
**Don't** introduce a second accent colour; Open Green is only the open-status dot.
**Don't** round corners or put cards inside cards.
